examples.en: We find, quite interestingly, men are more affected than women.
examples.zh: 很有趣的是，我们发现男性比女性更容易受到影响。

examples.en: Interestingly, apologizing can even have positive health benefits.
examples.zh: 有趣的是，道歉甚至对健康有益。

examples.en: Interestingly, there are clams and snail shells; but, no fossils of fish.
examples.zh: 有趣的是，那里有蛤蜊和蜗牛壳，但是，没有鱼的化石。
